# v0.4.4 — release tooling, launch kit

Full changelog:
[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/cyberd4ch/txn-agent/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

**One-command release.** `scripts/release.sh X.Y.Z "summary"` takes a tag from
idea to pushed in one step: it refuses to run unless you are on a clean `main`
in sync with origin, runs the exact CI gate locally (ruff, mypy strict, pytest
with the 85% coverage floor), bumps the version in `pyproject.toml`, scaffolds
the CHANGELOG entry and release notes, then commits, tags, and pushes main +
tag. `--dry-run` validates without touching anything; `--no-push` stops before
pushing. Documented in `docs/deploy.md` section 9.

**Launch publish sheet.** [docs/launch/publish-sheet.md](docs/launch/publish-sheet.md)
collects the final, paste-ready text for Show HN, r/AI_Agents, r/LocalLLaMA,
r/SideProject, and LinkedIn, with posting windows, the first-comment strategy,
and a per-platform checklist. Stats across all launch docs verified against the
suite: 67 tests, 86% coverage.

**67 tests · 86% coverage · ruff + mypy strict clean · assets built by CI from this tag**
